## source_to_kb

### meals_ext_cep_balance_refund
- Rule sentences 1–3 (CEP campuses serve free; the replaced_by refund basis for inactive vs CEP-active accounts; payout of the CEP refund amount, rest stays) → cep_campus_balance_refunds "Rule" verbatim + "Which accounts are refunded" table (equivalent; adds no case).
- Prerequisites, all `form: action`, each verbatim in cep_campus_balance_refunds and in no other doc:
  - "A CEP refund is not paid until every departure rollover owed from the inactive account of a sibling who left for another state or country has been made." Basis: departure_rollover_out_of_state §1, §3 + Daniel `moved_out_of_state`, 101.85.
  - "A CEP refund is not paid until the household has made the repayment-plan payment due today on every other active account of the household whose unpaid meal charges are at least the online deposit minimum." Basis: active_account_repayment_plan Terms ("the repayment payment due today on an active meal account …") + Samuel −48.45.
  - "A CEP refund is not paid until every rollover owed from a graduate's inactive account in the household has been made." Basis: graduate_balance_rollover + Grace `graduated`, 84.80.
  Strength ("not paid until"), connective and form intact.
- Baseline (whole balance, nothing kept, nothing held) → cep_refund_amount, with assembly (keep summed, then keep and holds subtracted) and result (round once; below refund minimum 5.00 → none). Complete.
- Factors (5): check hold → cep_refund_check_deposit_hold; card hold → cep_refund_card_deposit_hold (3 tiers each, 12-month returned test on "the account", 1-/2-month windows); keep milk → cep_refund_keep_for_milk ("kept for every serving day left in the month" / once / nothing); keep second meal → cep_refund_keep_for_second_meals; keep snacks → cep_refund_keep_for_snacks (month before / earlier month / nothing, with the earlier-month definition). The rule's serving-days-left sentence (no factor of its own; used by the milk and second-meal tiers) is carried in both those factor documents. Exact.
- Overwrite: both superseded clauses written as retired in refunds_transfers_and_closing; replaced_by texts in force in the CEP hub; the base doc's other four clauses still in force. No undeclared retirement.

### meals_ext_collection_repayment (active-account plan)
- Rule (household request or a quote of the payment due today on an active account owing ≥ minimum → plan; parent's own act; no fee; inactive accounts and one-deposit requests excluded) → active_account_repayment_plan Terms + "Which plan" table; tool block matches `pay_collection_meal_installment_be0f7285`.
- Baseline → active_account_repayment_payment (same assembly/result as the inactive plan). Complete.
- Factors (6): size, up front, household enrolled records, school calendar, last card payment, campus level (+2 high / +1 Hollis, Ridgecrest / 0 other or none) → active_plan_* docs. Every tier exact; the campus-level doc reads the enrolled campus and names the enrollment product.

### meals_ext_graduate_rollover
- Rule (graduate per completed record leaver `graduated`; receiving = active account with unpaid charges, largest when several; stated purpose; none → balance stays; withdrawn ≠ graduate; owed only if balance ≥ amount; residue stays) → graduate_balance_rollover verbatim + receiving-account table.
- Prerequisite `form: action` "The rollover amount is fixed only after the household has made the repayment-plan payment due today on the receiving account." → verbatim there only. Basis: active_account_repayment_plan + Samuel's record.
- Baseline (5 days × elementary lunch less receiving balance) → graduate_rollover_amount with order and result. Complete.
- Factors (6): serving days (4 tiers) → graduate_rollover_serving_days; lunch (enrolled campus) → graduate_rollover_lunch_charge; breakfast → graduate_rollover_breakfast; milk → graduate_rollover_milk; second meal → graduate_rollover_second_meals; snacks → graduate_rollover_snacks. Exact.

### meals_ext_departure_rollover
- Rule (out-of-state/home-country leaver; receiving = youngest active student whose account campus is not CEP; stated purpose; all-CEP → stays; refund-check alternative; other leaver reasons excluded; owed only if balance ≥ amount) → departure_rollover_out_of_state §1–§3 + receiving table.
- Prerequisite `form: action` "The departure rollover amount is fixed only after every graduate rollover owed to the receiving account has been made." → verbatim §4 only. Basis: graduate_balance_rollover + Grace's record.
- Baseline (20 days × lunch charge at the account's campus, secondary at Ridgecrest/CCHS/MRHS, elementary elsewhere non-CEP; less balance) → departure_rollover_amount "Amount", "Lunch charge", "Balance", "Assembly". Complete (the baseline's own lunch sentence correctly stays in the computation document; there is no lunch factor).
- Factors (5): serving days (10 tiers) → departure_rollover_serving_days; breakfast, milk, second meal, snacks → departure_rollover_* docs. Exact.
